newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen losing steam after upturn.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen losing steam after upturn.

text.p: Polish shares on Thursday were not expected to continue much further their previous day's 1.1 percent rise, which followed a three-session 5.2-percent drop deepened by concerns on the flooding in southern Poland.
Analysts said the market probably had little upside in coming weeks as investors waited to see to what degree Poland's planned 2.8-percent 1997 budget deficit might be affected by flood relief aid.
KGHM starts continuous trade on Thursday.
Polifarb Wroclaw, Rafako, ZEW and Viscoplast remained suspended due to the flooding.
